name: Sex Ed. With Richard & Mr. Dickinson
source:
Richard and his father have moved to a new country to start their lives over. In their haste to do so, Richard made an unfortunate blunder. While filling his documents, the air-headed man neglected to supply the government with his high-school diploma.

Now he's required to resit his exams. Should be easy, right? Well, not if one of them is for a class Richard has never taken before, Sex Ed. It's up to Mr. Dickinson to educate his son, while the two spend time bonding over their past.

[From [url=https://imrikun.itch.io/sexed]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
理查德和他的父亲搬到了一个新的国家，重新开始他们的生活。在他们匆忙这样做的过程中，理查德犯了一个不幸的错误。在填写文件时，这名愚蠢的男子忘记向政府提供他的高中文凭。

现在他被要求重考。应该很容易吧？好吧，如果其中一门是理查德以前从未上过的课程，即性教育课程，则不会。迪金森先生负责教育他的儿子，而两人则花时间回忆自己的过去。

[来自[url=https://imrikun.itch.io/sexed]itch.io[/url]]
